items.title: The murky AI milestone that has some of the industry’s leading voices increasingly on edge
items.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and others are warning that AI models may be able to build on themselves, without the help of humans. It’s a concept known as recursive self-improvement.

items.title: The oil market is sending an increasingly loud warning about gas prices at the pump
items.description: Oil buyers are paying much more to get a barrel of crude oil immediately as the Iran conflict threatens global supplies.

items.title: CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks lead software stocks to a never-before-seen feat
items.description: The software sector outperformed the chip sector to a historic degree in the face of escalating AI fears.

items.title: Chip stocks were a safe AI play. Now they’ve turned into the market’s pain trade.
items.description: A slowdown in the pace of AI development wouldn’t necessary dent spending, but there are other reasons semiconductor investors may want to take a measured approach.

items.title: I want to pay for every customer at my late husband’s favorite restaurant on his birthday. Am I crazy to do this?
items.description: “I’m concerned that my card issuers might freeze or flag the cards when they suddenly see an extraordinary number of transactions.”

items.title: Micron, Nvidia and other chip stocks fall after tech leaders call for an AI slowdown. Here’s what to know.
items.description: Analysts don’t expect the push for more responsible AI development to derail data-center spending.

items.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits 5% as oil prices jump and Fed meeting looms
items.description: The key “affordability” rate briefly touched its highest level since 2007 on Monday.

items.title: The 10 most overvalued housing markets in America
items.description: As home prices remain near record highs, about 81% of housing markets in America are overvalued, a new ratings-agency report says, with the Northeast leading the pack.

items.title: ‘I still don’t have my MRI’: My health insurer canceled my plan without warning. Is that legal?
items.description: “It wasn’t an ACA plan, but it was meaningfully cheaper than anything I could find on the ACA exchange.”

items.title: Saudi Arabia may be just days away from not being able to export much oil
items.description: The oil exporting kingdom is now dealing with the shutdown of its East-West pipeline. Energy prices ‘are only going to rise on the back of this.’
